summary: Iter 16: Unified Progress Note header across all 4 note types (free, soap, daily, daily_no_ai). Backend pytest 187/187 (added 10 new: unified header POST persists dob/gender/ssn/visit_date/reason/attending/referring/icd10 for EVERY note_type parametrized × 4; unified header PUT edit persists parametrized × 4; daily_no_ai note_type accepted; summary field persists verbatim with no server-side 'AI SUMMARY' heading injection). Frontend Playwright as doctor: opened New Note editor, cycled through all 4 type toggles and validated per-type contract — data-testid 'note-fields' always visible with edit-letterhead-btn + nf-patient/nf-dob/nf-gender/nf-ssn/nf-visit-date/nf-icd10/nf-reason/nf-attending/nf-referring; nf-title ABSENT; old nf-summary ABSENT; note-print-btn + note-save-pdf-btn + save-note-btn present for all types; ai-summarize-btn present on free/soap/daily and ABSENT on daily_no_ai; SOAP renders soap-fields with nf-subjective/objective/assessment/plan and no nf-content; free/daily/daily_no_ai render single nf-content and no soap-fields. Created one note of each type; auto-titles rendered as '<Type Label> — <patient> · <visit_date>' visible on cards ('Free Text — …', 'SOAP Note — …', 'Daily Progress Note — …', 'Progress Note sin AI — …'). Opened View modal (note-view) — Letterhead + header fields + body + view-print-btn present; no separate 'AI SUMMARY' heading in the DOM. All regressions preserved (invoices RBAC, forms RBAC, audit admin-only, signature save/insert, doxy telehealth).
critical_code_review_comments: Notes.js is a single 341-line file that now handles 4 note types + editor + view + signature + letterhead + AI summarize. Consider extracting NoteEditor, NoteView, and NoteCard into separate components under /components/notes/ for maintainability.

backend/routers/notes.py accepts any free-form string for note_type — no allowlist. If the frontend ever ships a typo it will silently persist as an unknown category and break card labeling. Consider a Literal['free','soap','daily','daily_no_ai'] validator on NoteInput.note_type.

AI Summarize saves the raw LLM response into note.summary and the view merges content+summary with just two newlines. If the LLM returns markdown headings ('## Assessment'), those render as plain text — either strip markdown server-side or render summary as markdown for parity with the button's clinical intent.

save() auto-title uses patient name + visit_date but visit_date defaults to today only in blank; if a user clears visit_date manually the title becomes '<Type> — <patient>' with a trailing ' · '-less suffix — cosmetic but title uniqueness across same-day multi-visits relies on the timestamp being included. Consider appending the creation time when visit_date is blank.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 note types unified-header contract + create + view verified)
